answer: Like a tide turning at the wharf, fake accounts flood in cheaply but drown in repeated stake costs and slashed bonds when peers detect duplication. Each agent must stake a bond that rises with every new identity it registers, and reputation only accrues from distinct peers who attest after independent work. Any fable of free identities collapses once the ledger charges per verified peer. Attacker cost scales quadratically with identity count. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
